envelope.reason: the difference between role-named agents and named personas lived only in the operator's head; the design used persona in persona launch and persona badge without saying what one is
envelope.cause: operator: role-named agents are generic with minimal residue; personally named agents are individuals with specialty, personality and self-constancy; mav's archetype is the residue above architect

payload.gloss: an agent named as an individual rather than for the role it holds. An agent named for its role (architect, planner, implementer, assayer, integrator) is the generic holder of that role and carries nothing beyond it. A persona holds a role and adds what the generic holder lacks, its residue: an archetype, a specialty or domain, a voice and a mark. mav is the architect role with mav's archetype above it; nico adds this corpus's canon; kino adds the craft of film-making. A persona is meant as an individual with self-constancy, the same one across sessions and kinds of work; the machinery self-constancy needs beyond the persona's definition, such as its own memory, continuity and presence outside a session, is outside cratylus for now. Why: the role and the one who holds it are different things, and a project that confuses them either strips its personas down to job titles or loads every generic agent with a personality no one asked for.
